summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V., a Dutch foreign private issuer, reporting share purchases under its long-term incentive plan. On August 18, 2026, the company announced it would enter forward contracts to acquire up to 5.5 million ordinary shares to cover LTIP obligations. The update details transactions from August 18-21, 2026, purchasing approximately 1.36 million shares at average prices ranging from €16.46 to €16.95 per share, for a total of about €22.78 million. Purchases were executed across Euronext, CBOE, DXE, and Turquoise venues. This is an issuer share repurchase aimed at employee compensation, not a standalone special situation.
